title: Marguerite and the Orbit
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Tamsin Oyelaran, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
